answer: Aim for long single study blocks of 4–6 hours so your brain stays in the zone; skipping short breaks prevents context switching and distraction; take one large multi-vitamin or coffee pill at the start of the session to boost energy and concentration; deep-space every study corner so you are forced to concentrate (even if you have only a few inches); cliff-jump straight into the hardest section first while caffeine is still working so you don’t waste time; and multitask by listening to podcasts in the background as background noise actually reinforces focus and memory.
